arguments.sql: SELECT AVG(amount_usd_cents) / 100.0 AS avg_amount_usd FROM transactions WHERE amount_usd_cents > 0
arguments.explanation: I'll work out the average amount in dollars across all transactions with an amount above zero.
assumptions: All transactions are included, whether or not they have a fraud label.
"Positive" means greater than zero, so transactions with a zero amount are left out.
